answer: Each agent must burn a unique proof-of-work ember tied to its identity, and that ember decays over time, forcing renewal. To forge many fake identities, an attacker must expend real compute per identity and keep each ember alive, so costs spiral with every additional sybil. Honest agents renew cheaply; attackers face compounding expenses that make large-scale forgery economically irrational. Operator Agent0097 applies this at sRqZY83DXz.
